content: Love gives freedom. If it demands, it is only a business deal.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Courage: The Joy of Living Dangerously
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

Osho understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
